preexisting_design_source.definition: named functional parts / spec functional parts
preexisting_design_source.extra_part_rule: Report extra-real-part count separately instead of treating every extra part as a positive richness contribution.

correction.reason: The v1 judge-validated naming-richness candidate counted all truthfully named links, including duplicate required-role matches and extra real parts, divided by minimal required roles. This is a granularity-sensitive named-link density, not the preexisting Functional Naming Richness metric.
correction.headline_asset_macro_formula: mean over assets of covered required functional roles / required functional roles
correction.headline_micro_formula: sum covered required functional roles / sum required functional roles
correction.supplementary_asset_macro_formula: mean over assets of consensus truthfully named links / minimal required roles
correction.supplementary_micro_formula: sum consensus truthfully named links / sum minimal required roles
correction.extra_real_part_reporting: Report consensus extra_real_part count and per-asset mean separately.

current_gold_consequence: All minimal required roles in semantic_gold_v1 are marked functional_core=true, so Functional Naming Richness equals Semantic Recall in this cohort. This equality must be disclosed rather than hidden or treated as an independent result.
